Definition: Potentially distinguishable using seasonal multispectral / phenological dynamics (high delta-NDVI, rapid green-up, distinct senescence, or monotypic invasive thicket structure)
Herb_Taxa: Parthenium hysterophorus, Senna tora, Hyptis suaveolens
Shrub_Taxa: Lantana camara (monotypic thickets on overburden / scrub)
Key_Remote_Sensing_Mechanisms: Extreme wet-season NDVI amplitude (>0.35 delta-NDVI), rapid red-edge shift (B05-B07), high green-up slope in July-August, dry-season canopy collapse or persistent evergreen contrast.

Definition: Potentially distinguishable only as a vegetation community / functional growth-form group (e.g. mixed thorny scrub, perennial woody shrub layer, riparian herbaceous cluster)
Herb_Taxa: Cynodon dactylon (grassland patch), Chromolaena odorata (scandent thicket), Furcraea foetida
Shrub_Taxa: Woodfordia fruticosa, Carissa carandas, Ziziphus mauritiana, Holarrhena antidysenterica, Calotropis procera, Nyctanthes arbor-tristis, Nerium oleander
Key_Remote_Sensing_Mechanisms: Intermediate seasonal stability, elevated winter persistence (NDVI_winter / NDVI_monsoon > 0.65), moderate SWIR moisture retention; identifiable as woody understory stratum rather than single species.

Definition: Not realistically identifiable from Sentinel-2 10-20 m imagery alone (sub-pixel shade-adapted forbs, prostrate weeds, or diffuse low-cover ground layer under dense overstory tree crowns)
Herb_Taxa: Acalypha indica, Diplazium esculentum, Tridax procumbens, Achyranthes aspera, Sida cordifolia, Macroptilium lathyroides
Key_Remote_Sensing_Mechanisms: Spatial fraction <10% of pixel area; canopy closure of Shorea robusta, Ficus, Mangifera or Tectona completely occludes ground-layer optical signal.
